simple.text: Orqa miya oldingi şoxidagi yirik motoneyronning AP si **nerv-muskul birikmasi**da atsetilxolin (ACh) çiqarilişi orqali muskul tolasida AP ga aylanadi. Bu AP **T-nayçalar** orqali tola içiga kiradi va dihidropiridin–rianodin reseptorlari orqali SR dan Ca²⁺ çiqaradi — **qözğaliş-qisqariş boğlanişi**.

items.text: Har nerv tolasi 3 dan bir neça yuzgaça muskul tolasini innervatsiya qiladi; birikma tola örtasida; ~2% dan taşqari har tolada bitta.
**Motor oxirgi plastinka** — muskul yuzasiga botgan nerv terminallari, Şvann hujayralari bilan qoplangan.
**Sinaptik ariqça**, **sinaptik yoriq** 20–30 nm; tubida **subneyral burmalar** (yuzani oşiradi).
Terminalda mitoxondriyalar (ATP — ACh sintezi uçun); bitta plastinkada ~300 000 sinaptik pufakça. Yoriqda **atsetilxolinesteraza** — ACh ni bir neça ms da parçalaydi.
Har impulsda ~125 pufakça böşaydi.

Nerv membranasining içki yuzasida **ziç çiziqlar**; ularning ikki tomonida **kuçlanişga boğliq Ca²⁺ kanallari**. AP → Ca²⁺ kiradi → (taxminan) Ca²⁺-kalmodulin boğliq proteinkinaza → **sinapsin**larni fosforlaydi → pufakçalar sitoskeletdan böşab **faol zonaga** borib, ekzotsitoz bilan böşaydi.

Bosqiçlar (p.95): (1) ~40 nm pufakçalar motoneyron tanasidagi Goljida hosil bölib akson böylab oqim bilan keladi; (2) ACh terminal sitozolida sintezlanib pufakçalarga töplanadi (~10 000 molekula/pufakça); (3) AP terminal içida Ca²⁺ ni ~100 baravar oşiradi → pufakça birlaşiş tezligi ~10 000 baravar ortadi; (4) bir neça ms da ACh esteraza bilan **atsetat + xolin**ga parçalanadi, xolin qayta sörilib işlatiladi (butun ketma-ketlik 5–10 ms). Zaxira bir neça ming impulsga yetadi; yangi pufakçalar **klatrinli qoplangan çuqurçalar** orqali ~20 s da hosil böladi.

**ACh reseptori** — MW ~275 000; homilada 2α, β, δ, γ; kattalarda γ örniga **ε**. Ikki ACh ikki α subbirlikka boğlanganda kanal oçiladi: diametri ~0,65 nm, Na⁺, K⁺, Ca²⁺ ötadi; oğzidagi manfiy zaryadlar Cl⁻ ni ötkazmaydi. Bitta kanal 1 ms da 15 000–30 000 Na⁺ ötkazadi.
Asosan Na⁺ kiradi: ECF da Na⁺ köp va içki −80...−90 mV Na⁺ ni tortib K⁺ çiqişiga tösqinlik qiladi.
**Oxirgi plastinka potensiali (EPP)**: +50–75 mV mahalliy siljiş; 20–30 mV dan ortiq kötariliş odatda AP ni boşlaş uçun yetarli (Fig. 7-4).
EPP zaiflaşuvi: **kurare** (ACh bilan reseptor uçun raqobat), **botulin toksini** (ACh çiqişini kamaytiradi).
**Xavfsizlik omili**: EPP kerakligidan ~3 baravar katta. >100 Hz da bir neça daqiqa qözğatilsa pufakçalar tugaydi — **birikma çarçoqi** (amalda faqat eng oğir işda).
**ACh ga öxşaş** (esteraza parçalamaydi yoki sekin): metaxolin, karbaxol, **nikotin** → uzoq depolyarizatsiya, spazm.
**Antixolinesterazalar**: **neostigmin**, **fizostigmin** (bir neça soat), **diizopropil-ftorfosfat** (nerv gazi, haftalab) → ACh töplanadi, spazm, laringospazm bilan ölim.
**Kurare-simon** blokatorlar: **d-tubokurarin**.

simple.text: ~1/20 000 kişida. ACh reseptorlariga qarşi **autoantitelolar** → EPP Na⁺ kanallarini oçişga yetmaydi → zaiflik; oğir holda nafas muskullari tufayli ölim. **Neostigmin** bir neça soatga yaxşilaydi.

items.text: Tinçlik potensiali −80...−90 mV (neyrondan 10–20 mV manfiyroq).
AP davomiyligi 1–5 ms (yirik miyelinli nervdan ~5 baravar uzun).
Ötkaziş tezligi 3–5 m/s (yirik miyelinli nervning ~1/13 qismi).

**T-nayçalar** — hujayra membranasining içki davomlari, taşqi suyuqlikka oçiq; tolani köndalang kesib ötadi va tarmoqlanadi. Qurbaqada sarkomerga 1 ta (Z diskda), sutemizuvçilar yuragida ham şunday; sutemizuvçilar skelet muskulida sarkomerga 2 ta (A–I çegarasida).
**SR**: T-nayçaga tegib turgan **terminal sisternalar** + miofibrillalarni örab olgan böylama nayçalar.
T-nayça AP → kuçlaniş sensori **dihidropiridin (DHP) reseptorlari** → SR dagi **rianodin reseptori (RyR)** Ca²⁺ çiqariş kanallari oçiladi (bir neça ms) → Ca²⁺ sarkoplazmaga.
**SERCA** (SR Ca²⁺-ATPaza) Ca²⁺ ni ~10 000 baravar konsentratsiyalaydi; içkarida **kalsekvestrin** (bir molekula 40 tagaça Ca²⁺).

**Ca²⁺ impulsi**: tinçlikda <10⁻⁷ M (qisqarişga yetmaydi); qözğalişda 2 × 10⁻⁴ M gaça (~500 baravar, maksimal qisqariş uçun kerakligidan ~10 baravar köp). Skelet muskulida ~1/20 s; yurakda ~1/3 s (uzun AP). Uzoq qisqariş uçun qator AP lar kerak.

simple.text: Moyil odamlarda **galotan, izofluran** yoki **suksinilxolin** qözğatadi; kamida 6 mutatsiya, ayniqsa RyR va DHP reseptorlari genlarida → SR dan nazoratsiz Ca²⁺ çiqişi → kuçli qisqariş, metabolizm keskin oşadi, issiqlik, hujayra atsidozi, energiya tugaşi. Belgilar: muşak rigidligi, yuqori isitma, taxikardiya; oğir holda **rabdomioliz** va **giperkaliyemiya**. Davo: tez sovutiş va **dantrolen** (RyR antagonisti).
AP → 5-bob; aktin-miozin mexanizmi → 6-bob; yurakda Ca²⁺ ning T-nayçalardan ham kirişi → 9-bob; MNS sinapslari va çarçoqi → 46-bob; avtonom mediatorlar → 61-bob.

full.text: NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTION AND TRANSMISSION OF IMPULSES FROM NERVE ENDINGS TO SKELETAL MUSCLE FIBERS

Skeletal muscle fibers are innervated by large myelinated nerve fibers that originate from large motoneurons in the anterior horns of the spinal cord. As discussed in Chap ter 6, each nerve fiber, after entering the muscle belly, normally branches and stimulates from three to several hundred skeletal muscle fibers. Each nerve ending makes a junction, called the _neuromuscular junction_, with the muscle fiber near its midpoint. The action potential initi ated in the muscle fiber by the nerve signal travels in both directions toward the muscle fiber ends. With the excep tion of about 2% of the muscle fibers, there is only one such junction per muscle fiber.
PHYSIOLOGIC ANATOMY OF THE NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTION—THE MOTOR END PLATE

**Figure 7-1A** and **B** shows the neuromuscular junction from a large myelinated nerve fiber to a skeletal muscle fiber. The nerve fiber forms a complex of _branching nerve terminals_ that invaginate into the surface of the muscle fiber but lie outside the muscle fiber plasma membrane. The entire structure is called the _motor end plate._ It is cov ered by one or more Schwann cells that insulate it from the surrounding fluids.

**Figure 7-1C** shows the junction between a single axon terminal and the muscle fiber membrane. The invaginated membrane is called the _synaptic gutter_ or _synaptic trough_, and the space between the terminal and the fiber mem brane is called the _synaptic space_ or _synaptic cleft,_ which is 20 to 30 nanometers wide. At the bottom of the gut ter are numerous smaller _folds_ of the muscle membrane called _subneural clefts_, which greatly increase the surface area at which the synaptic transmitter can act.

In the axon terminal are many mitochondria that sup ply adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the energy source used for synthesis of a transmitter, _acetylcholine,_ which excites the muscle fiber membrane. Acetylcholine is synthesized in the cytoplasm of the terminal but is absorbed rap idly into many small _synaptic vesicles_, about 300,000 of which are normally in the terminals of a single end plate. In the synaptic space are large quantities of the enzyme _acetylcholinesterase_, which destroys acetylcholine a few milliseconds after it has been released from the synaptic vesicles.
SECRETION OF ACETYLCHOLINE BY THE NERVE TERMINALS

When a nerve impulse reaches the neuromuscular junc tion, about 125 vesicles of acetylcholine are released from the terminals into the synaptic space. Some of the details of this mechanism can be seen in **Figure 7-2**, which shows an expanded view of a synaptic space with the neu ral membrane above and the muscle membrane and its subneural clefts below.

On the inside surface of the neural membrane are lin ear _dense bars_, shown in cross section in **Figure 7-2**. To each side of each dense bar are protein particles that pen etrate the neural membrane; these are _voltage-gated cal cium channels_. When an action potential spreads over the terminal, these channels open and allow calcium ions to diffuse from the synaptic space to the interior of the nerve terminal. The calcium ions, in turn, are believed to acti vate _Ca2+-calmodulin–dependent protein kinase_, which, in turn, phosphorylates _synapsin_ proteins that anchor the acetylcholine vesicles to the cytoskeleton of the pre synaptic terminal. This process frees the acetylcholine vesicles from the cytoskeleton and allows them to move to the _active zone_ of the presynaptic neural membrane adjacent to the dense bars. The vesicles then dock at the release sites, fuse with the neural membrane, and empty their acetylcholine into the synaptic space by the process of _exocytosis_.

Although some of the aforementioned details are spec ulative, it is known that the effective stimulus for causing acetylcholine release from the vesicles is entry of calcium ions and that acetylcholine from the vesicles is then emp tied through the neural membrane adjacent to the dense bars.

**Figure 7-2** also shows many small _acetyl choline receptors_ and _voltage-gated sodium channels_ in the muscle fiber membrane. The _acetylcholine-gated ion channels_ are located almost entirely near the mouths of the subneural clefts lying immediately below the dense bar areas, where the acetylcholine is emptied into the syn aptic space. The voltage-gated sodium channels also line the subneural clefts.
full.lead: Acetylcholine Opens Ion Channels on Postsynaptic Membranes.

full.text: Each acetylcholine receptor is a protein complex that has a total molecular weight of approximately 275,000. The fetal acetylcholine receptor complex is composed of five subunit proteins, two _alpha_ proteins and one each of _beta, delta_, and _gamma_ proteins. In the adult, an _epsilon_ protein substitutes for the gamma protein in this recep tor complex. These protein molecules penetrate all the way through the membrane, lying side by side in a circle to form a tubular channel, illustrated in **Figure 7-3**. The channel remains constricted, as shown in part A of the figure, until two acetylcholine molecules attach respec tively to the two _alpha_ subunit proteins. This attachment causes a conformational change that opens the channel, as shown in part B of the figure.

The acetylcholine-gated channel has a diameter of about 0.65 nanometer, which is large enough to allow the important positive ions—sodium (Na+), potassium (K+), and calcium (Ca2+)—to move easily through the opening. Patch clamp studies have shown that one of these chan nels, when opened by acetylcholine, can transmit 15,000 to 30,000 sodium ions in 1 millisecond. Conversely, nega tive ions, such as chloride ions, do not pass through because of strong negative charges in the mouth of the channel that repel these negative ions.

In practice, far more sodium ions flow through the acetylcholine-gated channels than any other ions for two reasons. First, there are only two positive ions present in large concentrations—sodium ions in the extracellular fluid and potassium ions in the intracel lular fluid. Second, the negative potential on the inside of the muscle membrane, −80 to −90 millivolts, pulls the positively charged sodium ions to the inside of the fiber while simultaneously preventing efflux of the pos itively charged potassium ions when they attempt to pass outward.

As shown in **Figure 7-3B**, the principal effect of open ing the acetylcholine-gated channels is to allow sodium ions to flow to the inside of the fiber, carrying positive charges with them. This action creates a local positive potential change inside the muscle fiber membrane, called the _end plate potential._ This end plate potential normally causes sufficient depolarization to open neighboring voltage-gated sodium channels, allowing even greater sodium ion inflow and initiating an action potential that spreads along the muscle membrane and causes muscle contraction.

The acetylcholine, once released into the synaptic space, continues to activate acetylcholine re ceptors as long as the acetylcholine persists in the space. However, it is rapidly destroyed by the enzyme _acetylcho linesterase_, which is attached mainly to the spongy layer of fine connective tissue that fills the synaptic space be tween the presynaptic nerve terminal and the postsynap tic muscle membrane. A small amount of acetylcholine diffuses out of the synaptic space and is then no longer available to act on the muscle fiber membrane.
full.lead: Destruction of the Released Acetylcholine by Acetylcholinesterase.

full.text: The short time that the acetylcholine remains in the synaptic space—a few milliseconds at most—normally is sufficient to excite the muscle fiber. Then the rapid removal of the acetylcholine prevents continued muscle re-excitation after the muscle fiber has recovered from its initial action potential.

The sudden insurgence of sodium ions into the muscle fiber when the acetylcholine-gated chan nels open causes the electrical potential inside the fiber at the _local area of the end plate_ to increase in the positive direction as much as 50 to 75 millivolts, creating a _local potential_ called the _end plate potential_. Recall from Chap ter 5 that a sudden increase in nerve membrane potential of more than 20 to 30 millivolts is normally sufficient to initiate more and more sodium channel opening, thus ini tiating an action potential at the muscle fiber membrane.
full.lead: End Plate Potential and Excitation of the Skeletal Muscle Fiber.

full.text: **Figure 7-4** illustrates an end plate potential initiat ing the action potential. This figure shows three separate end plate potentials. End plate potentials A and C are too weak to elicit an action potential, but they do pro duce weak local end plate voltage changes, as recorded in the figure. By contrast, end plate potential B is much stronger and causes enough sodium channels to open so that the self-regenerative effect of more and more sodium ions flowing to the interior of the fiber initiates an action potential. The weakness of the end plate potential at point A was caused by poisoning of the muscle fiber with _curare_, a drug that blocks the gating action of ace tylcholine on the acetylcholine channels by competing for the acetylcholine receptor sites. The weakness of the end plate potential at point C resulted from the effect of _botu linum toxin_, a bacterial poison that decreases the quantity of acetylcholine release by the nerve terminals.

Ordinarily, each impulse that arrives at the neuromuscular junction causes about three times as much end plate potential as that required to stimulate the muscle fiber. Therefore, the normal neuromuscular junction is said to have a high _safety factor_. However, stimulation of the nerve fiber at rates greater than 100 times per second for several min utes may diminish the number of acetylcholine vesicles so much that impulses fail to pass into the muscle fiber. This situation is called _fatigue_ of the neuromuscular junction, and it is the same effect that causes fatigue of synapses in the central nervous system when the synapses are overex cited. Under normal functioning conditions, measurable fatigue of the neuromuscular junction occurs rarely and, even then, only at the most exhausting levels of muscle activity.
full.lead: Safety Factor for Transmission at the Neuromuscular Junction—Fatigue of the Junction.

full.text: Acetylcholine formation and release at the neuromuscular junction occur in the following stages: 1. Small vesicles, about 40 nanometers in size, are formed by the Golgi apparatus in the cell body of the motoneu ron in the spinal cord. These vesicles are then trans ported by axoplasm that streams through the core of the axon from the central cell body in the spinal cord all the way to the neuromuscular junction at the tips of the peripheral nerve fibers. About 300,000 of these small vesicles collect in the nerve terminals of a single skeletal muscle end plate. 2. Acetylcholine is synthesized in the cytosol of the nerve fiber terminal but is immediately transported through the membranes of the vesicles to their interior, where it is stored in highly concentrated form—about 10,000 molecules of acetylcholine in each vesicle. 3. When an action potential arrives at the nerve terminal, it opens many _calcium channels_ in the membrane of the nerve terminal because this terminal has an abundance of voltage-gated calcium channels. As a result, the cal cium ion concentration inside the terminal membrane increases about 100-fold, which in turn increases the rate of fusion of the acetylcholine vesicles with the ter minal membrane about 10,000-fold. This fusion makes many of the vesicles rupture, allowing _exocytosis_ of ace tylcholine into the synaptic space. About 125 vesicles usually rupture with each action potential. Then, after a few milliseconds, the acetylcholine is split by acetylcho linesterase into acetate ion and choline, and the choline is actively reabsorbed into the neural terminal to be re used to form new acetylcholine. This sequence of events occurs within a period of 5 to 10 milliseconds. 4. The number of vesicles available in the nerve ending is sufficient to allow transmission of only a few thousand nerve to muscle impulses. Therefore, for continued function of the neuromuscular junction, new vesicles need to be re-formed rapidly. Within a few seconds after each action potential is over, coated pits appear in the terminal nerve membrane, caused by contractile pro teins in the nerve ending, especially the protein _clathrin_, which is attached to the membrane in the areas of the original vesicles. Within about 20 seconds, the proteins contract and cause the pits to break away to the interior of the membrane, thus forming new vesicles. Within another few seconds, acetylcholine is transported to the interior of these vesicles, and they are then ready for a new cycle of acetylcholine release.

Several compounds, including _methacholine, carbachol_, and _nicotine_, have nearly the same effect on the muscle fiber as acetylcholine. The main differences be tween these drugs and acetylcholine are that the drugs are not destroyed by cholinesterase or are destroyed so slowly that their action often persists for many minutes to several hours. The drugs work by causing localized areas of depo larization of the muscle fiber membrane at the motor end plate where the acetylcholine receptors are located. Then, every time the muscle fiber recovers from a previous con traction, these depolarized areas, by virtue of leaking ions, initiate a new action potential, thereby causing a state of muscle spasm.
full.lead: Drugs That Stimulate the Muscle Fiber by Acetylcholine-Like Action.

full.text: Three particularly well-known drugs—_neostigmine, physostigmine_, and _diiso propyl fluorophosphate_—inactivate acetylcholinesterase in the synapses so that it no longer hydrolyzes acetylcholine. Therefore, with each successive nerve impulse, additional acetylcholine accumulates and stimulates the muscle fiber repetitively. This activity causes _muscle spasm_ when even a few nerve impulses reach the muscle. Unfortunately, it can also cause death as a result of laryngeal spasm, which smothers a person.
full.lead: Drugs That Stimulate the Neuromuscular Junction by Inactivating Acetylcholinesterase.

full.text: Neostigmine and physostigmine combine with acetyl cholinesterase to inactivate the acetylcholinesterase for up to several hours, after which these drugs are displaced from the acetylcholinesterase so that the esterase once again be comes active. Conversely, diisopropyl fluorophosphate, which is a powerful nerve gas poison, inactivates acetylcho linesterase for weeks, which makes this poison particularly lethal.

A group of drugs known as _curariform drugs_ can prevent the passage of impulses from the nerve ending into the muscle. For example. d-tubocurarine blocks the action of acetylcholine on the muscle fiber acetylcholine receptors, thus preventing sufficient increase in permeability of the muscle membrane channels to initiate an action potential.
full.lead: Drugs That Block Transmission at the Neuromuscular Junction.

full.text: _Myasthenia gravis_, which occurs in about 1 in every 20,000 persons, causes muscle weakness because of the inability of the neuromuscular junctions to transmit enough signals from the nerve fibers to the muscle fibers. Antibodies that attack the acetylcholine receptors have been demonstrat ed in the blood of most patients with myasthenia gravis. Therefore, myasthenia gravis is believed to be an autoim mune disease in which the patients have developed anti bodies that block or destroy their own acetylcholine recep tors at the postsynaptic neuromuscular junction.

Regardless of the cause, the end plate potentials that occur in the muscle fibers are mostly too weak to initiate opening of the voltage-gated sodium channels, and muscle fiber depolarization does not occur. If the disease is intense enough, the patient may die of respiratory failure as a result of severe weakness of the respiratory muscles. The disease can usually be ameliorated for several hours by adminis tering _neostigmine_ or some other anticholinesterase drug, which allows larger than normal amounts of acetylcholine to accumulate in the synaptic space. Within minutes, some of those affected can begin to function almost normally un til a new dose of neostigmine is required a few hours later.
MUSCLE ACTION POTENTIAL

Almost everything discussed in Chapter 5 regarding the initiation and conduction of action potentials in nerve fibers applies equally to skeletal muscle fibers, except for quantitative differences. Some of the quantitative aspects of muscle potentials are as follows: 1. The resting membrane potential is about −80 to −90 millivolts in skeletal fibers, about 10 to 20 millivolts more negative than in neurons. 2. The duration of the action potential is 1 to 5 mil liseconds in skeletal muscle, about five times as long as in large myelinated nerves. 3. The velocity of conduction is 3 to 5 m/sec, about 1/13 the velocity of conduction in the large myeli nated nerve fibers that excite skeletal muscle.
Action Potentials Spread to the Interior of the Muscle Fiber by Way of Transverse Tubules

The skeletal muscle fiber is so large that action poten tials spreading along its surface membrane cause almost no current flow deep within the fiber. Maximum muscle contraction, however, requires the current to penetrate deeply into the muscle fiber to the vicinity of the separate myofibrils. This penetration is achieved by transmission of action potentials along _transverse tubules_ (T tubules) that penetrate all the way through the muscle fiber, from one side of the fiber to the other, as illustrated in **Figure 7-5**. The T tubule action poten tials cause release of calcium ions inside the muscle fiber in the immediate vicinity of the myofibrils, and these calcium ions then cause contraction. The overall process is called _excitation-contraction_ coupling.
EXCITATION-CONTRACTION COUPLING
Transverse Tubule–Sarcoplasmic Reticulum System

**Figure 7-5** shows myofibrils surrounded by the T tubule– sarcoplasmic reticulum system. The T tubules are small and run transverse to the myofibrils. They begin at the cell membrane and penetrate all the way from one side of the muscle fiber to the opposite side. Not shown in the figure is that these tubules branch among themselves and form entire _planes_ of T tubules interlacing among all the separate myofibrils. Also, _where the T tubules originate from the cell membrane, they are open to the exterior of the muscle fiber._ Therefore, they communicate with the extracellular fluid surrounding the muscle fiber and con tain extracellular fluid in their lumens. In other words, _the T tubules are actually internal extensions of the cell mem brane_. Therefore, when an action potential spreads over a muscle fiber membrane, a potential change also spreads along the T tubules to the deep interior of the muscle fiber. The electrical currents surrounding these T tubules then elicit the muscle contraction.

**Figure 7-5** also shows a sarcoplasmic _reticulum_, in yellow. This sarcoplasmic reticulum is composed of two major parts: (1) large chambers called _terminal cisternae_ that abut the T tubules; and (2) long longitudinal tubules that surround all surfaces of the contracting myofibrils.
Release of Calcium Ions by the Sarcoplasmic Reticulum

One of the special features of the sarcoplasmic reticulum is that within its vesicular tubules is an excess of calcium ions in high concentration. Many of these ions are released from each vesicle when an action potential occurs in the adjacent T tubule.

**Figures 7-6 and 7-7** show that the action potential of the T tubule causes current flow into the sarcoplasmic reticular cisternae where they abut the T tubule. As the action potential reaches the T tubule, the voltage change is sensed by dihydropyridine _receptors_ linked to _calcium release channels_, also called _ryanodine receptor channels_, in the adjacent sarcoplasmic reticular cisternae (see **Fig ure 7-6**). Activation of dihydropyridine receptors triggers the opening of the calcium release channels in the cister nae, as well as in their attached longitudinal tubules. These channels remain open for a few milliseconds, releasing calcium ions into the sarcoplasm surrounding the myo fibrils and causing contraction, as discussed in Chapter 6.

Once the calcium ions have been released from the sarcoplasmic tubules and have diffused among the myofibrils, muscle contraction continues as long as the calcium ion concen tration remains high. However, a continually active calcium pump located in the walls of the sarcoplasmic reticulum pumps calcium ions away from the myofibrils back into the sarcoplasmic tubules (see **Figure 7-6**). This pump, called SERCA (**s**arcoplasmic **r**eticulum **C**a2+-**A**TPase), can concentrate the calcium ions about 10,000-fold inside the tubules. In addition, inside the reticulum is a _calciumbinding protein_ called _calsequestrin,_ which can bind up to 40 calcium ions for each molecule of calsequestrin.
full.lead: Calcium Pump Removes Calcium Ions from the Myofibrillar Fluid After Contraction Occurs.

full.text: The normal resting state concentration (<10−7 molar) of calcium ions in the cytosol that bathes the myofibrils is too little to elicit con traction. Therefore, the troponin-tropomyosin complex keeps the actin filaments inhibited and maintains a re laxed state of the muscle.

Conversely, full excitation of the T tubule and sar coplasmic reticulum system causes enough release of calcium ions to increase the concentration in the myo fibrillar fluid to as high as 2 × 10−4 molar concentration, a 500-fold increase, which is about 10 times the level required to cause maximum muscle contraction. Imme diately thereafter, the calcium pump depletes the calcium ions again. The total duration of this calcium pulse in the usual skeletal muscle fiber lasts about 1/20 of a second, although it may last several times as long in some fibers and several times less in others. In heart muscle, the cal cium pulse lasts about one-third of a second because of the long duration of the cardiac action potential.

During this calcium pulse, muscle contraction occurs. If the contraction is to continue without interruption for long intervals, a series of calcium pulses must be initiated by a continuous series of repetitive action potentials, as discussed in Chapter 6.

In susceptible individuals, _malignant hyperthermia_ and a _hypermetabolic crisis_ may be triggered by exposure to certain types of anesthetics, including halothane and iso flurane, or succinylcholine. At least six genetic mutations, especially of the ryanodine receptor or dihydropyridine receptor genes, have been shown to increase susceptibil ity greatly to developing malignant hyperthermia during anesthesia. Little is known about the specific mechanisms whereby anesthetics interact with these abnormal recep tors to trigger malignant hyperthermia. It is known, how ever, that these mutations cause unregulated passage of cal cium from the sarcoplasmic reticulum into the intracellular spaces, which in turn causes the muscle fibers to contract excessively. These sustained muscled contractions greatly increase metabolic rate, generating large amounts of heat and causing cellular acidosis, as a well as depletion of en ergy stores.

Symptoms of malignant include muscle rigidity, high fever, and rapid heart rate. Additional complications in se vere cases may include rapid breakdown of skeletal muscle (_rhabdomyolysis_) and a high plasma potassium level due to release of large amounts of potassium from damaged muscle cells. Treatment of malignant hyperthermia gener ally involves rapid cooling and the administration of _dant rolene_, a drug that antagonizes ryanodine receptors, which inhibits calcium ion release for the sarcoplasmic reticulum and thereby attenuating muscle contraction.

ch07-f0.text: Nerv-muskul sinapsi va impulslarning nerv uçlaridan skelet muskul tolalariga uzatilişi

ch07-f1.text: Skelet muskul tolalarini orqa miya oldingi şoxlaridagi yirik motoneyronlardan boşlanadigan yirik miyelinli nerv tolalari innervatsiya qiladi. 6-bobda muhokama qilinganidek, har bir nerv tolasi muskul qorinçasiga kirgaç, odatda tarmoqlanib, uçtadan bir neça yuztagaça skelet muskul tolasini qözğatadi. Har bir nerv uçi muskul tolasi bilan uning örta qismi yaqinida _nerv-muskul sinapsi_ (nerv-muskul birikmasi) deb ataladigan birikma hosil qiladi. Nerv signali muskul tolasida yuzaga keltirgan harakat potensiali muskul tolasining har ikki uçi tomon tarqaladi. Muskul tolalarining taxminan 2% idan taşqari, har bir muskul tolasida faqat bittadan şunday sinaps böladi.

ch07-f2.text: Nerv-muskul sinapsining fiziologik anatomiyasi — harakat oxirgi plastinkasi

ch07-f3.text: **Rasm 7-1A** va **B** da yirik miyelinli nerv tolasidan skelet muskul tolasiga ötuvçi nerv-muskul sinapsi körsatilgan. Nerv tolasi muskul tolasi yuzasiga botib kiradigan, biroq muskul tolasining plazmatik membranasidan taşqarida joylaşgan _tarmoqlanuvçi nerv terminallari_ majmuasini hosil qiladi. Bu butun tuzilma _harakat oxirgi plastinkasi_ (motor end plate) deb ataladi. Uni atrofdagi suyuqliklardan izolyatsiya qiluvçi bir yoki bir neçta Şvann hujayrasi qoplab turadi.

ch07-f5.text: **Rasm 7-1C** da bitta akson terminali bilan muskul tolasi membranasi örtasidagi birikma körsatilgan. Botib kirgan membrana _sinaptik ariqça_ yoki _sinaptik novça_ deb ataladi, terminal bilan tola membranasi orasidagi böşliq esa _sinaptik böşliq_ yoki _sinaptik yoriq_ deb ataladi; uning kengligi 20–30 nanometr. Ariqça tubida muskul membranasining köplab mayda _burmalari_ bölib, ular _nerv osti yoriqlari_ deb ataladi; bu burmalar sinaptik mediator ta’sir qila oladigan yuza maydonini ança kengaytiradi.

ch07-f6.text: Akson terminalida köplab mitoxondriyalar bölib, ular muskul tolasi membranasini qözğatuvçi mediator — _atsetilxolin_ sintezi uçun energiya manbai bölgan adenozintrifosfatni (ATF) yetkazib beradi. Atsetilxolin terminal sitoplazmasida sintezlanadi, biroq tezda köplab mayda _sinaptik pufakçalarga_ söriladi; me’yorda bitta oxirgi plastinka terminallarida bunday pufakçalar taxminan 300 000 ta böladi. Sinaptik böşliqda köp miqdorda _atsetilxolinesteraza_ fermenti bölib, u atsetilxolinni sinaptik pufakçalardan ajralib çiqqanidan bir neça millisekund ötgaç parçalaydi.

ch07-f8.text: Nerv impulsi nerv-muskul sinapsiga yetib kelganda terminallardan sinaptik böşliqqa atsetilxolinli taxminan 125 ta pufakça çiqariladi. Bu mexanizmning ayrim tafsilotlarini **Rasm 7-2** da köriş mumkin: unda sinaptik böşliq kattalaştirilgan holda körsatilgan bölib, yuqorida nerv membranasi, pastda esa muskul membranasi va uning nerv osti yoriqlari joylaşgan.

ch07-f10.text: Nerv membranasining içki yuzasida çiziqsimon _ziç tasmalar_ joylaşgan; ular **Rasm 7-2** da köndalang kesimda körsatilgan. Har bir ziç tasmaning ikki yonida nerv membranasini teşib ötuvçi oqsil zarraçalari bor; bular _potensialga boğliq kalsiy kanallari_. Harakat potensiali terminal böylab tarqalganda bu kanallar oçiladi va kalsiy ionlarining sinaptik böşliqdan nerv terminali içiga diffuziyalanişiga imkon beradi. Kalsiy ionlari öz navbatida _Ca2+-kalmodulinga boğliq proteinkinazani_ faollaştiradi, deb hisoblanadi; bu ferment esa atsetilxolin pufakçalarini presinaptik terminal sitoskeletiga boğlab turuvçi _sinapsin_ oqsillarini fosforlaydi. Bu jarayon atsetilxolin pufakçalarini sitoskeletdan böşatadi va ularning presinaptik nerv membranasining ziç tasmalarga qöşni _faol zonasiga_ harakatlanişiga imkon beradi. Söngra pufakçalar ajraliş joylariga birikadi, nerv membranasi bilan qöşiladi va _ekzotsitoz_ jarayoni orqali öz atsetilxolinini sinaptik böşliqqa böşatadi.

ch07-f11.text: Yuqorida keltirilgan tafsilotlarning ayrimlari taxminiy bölsa-da, pufakçalardan atsetilxolin ajralişini yuzaga keltiruvçi samarali ta’sirot kalsiy ionlarining kirişi ekani va pufakçalardagi atsetilxolin keyin ziç tasmalarga qöşni nerv membranasi orqali böşatilişi ma’lum.

ch07-f12.text: **Rasm 7-2** da, şuningdek, muskul tolasi membranasidagi köplab mayda _atsetilxolin retseptorlari_ va _potensialga boğliq natriy kanallari_ körsatilgan. _Atsetilxolinga boğliq ion kanallari_ deyarli butunlay atsetilxolin sinaptik böşliqqa böşatiladigan ziç tasma sohalarining bevosita ostida yotgan nerv osti yoriqlarining oğizlari yaqinida joylaşgan. Potensialga boğliq natriy kanallari ham nerv osti yoriqlarini qoplab turadi.
ch07-f12.lead: Atsetilxolin postsinaptik membranalardagi ion kanallarini oçadi.

ch07-f13.text: Har bir atsetilxolin retseptori umumiy molekulyar massasi taxminan 275 000 bölgan oqsil kompleksidir. Homila atsetilxolin retseptori kompleksi beşta subbirlik oqsildan iborat: ikkita _alfa_ oqsil hamda bittadan _beta, delta_ va _gamma_ oqsillar. Kattalarda bu retseptor kompleksida gamma oqsil örnini _epsilon_ oqsil egallaydi. Bu oqsil molekulalari membranani butunlay teşib ötadi va doira böylab yonma-yon joylaşib, **Rasm 7-3** da tasvirlangan naysimon kanalni hosil qiladi. Rasmning A qismida körsatilganidek, ikkita atsetilxolin molekulasi mos ravişda ikkita _alfa_ subbirlik oqsiliga birikmagunça kanal toraygan holda qoladi. Bu birikiş kanalni oçuvçi konformatsion özgarişga sabab böladi; bu rasmning B qismida körsatilgan.

ch07-f15.text: Atsetilxolinga boğliq kanalning diametri taxminan 0,65 nanometr bölib, bu muhim musbat ionlar — natriy (Na+), kaliy (K+) va kalsiy (Ca2+) ning teşik orqali oson ötişi uçun yetarli. Patch-klamp tadqiqotlari şuni körsatdiki, bunday kanallardan biri atsetilxolin ta’sirida oçilganda 1 millisekundda 15 000 dan 30 000 gaça natriy ionini ötkaza oladi. Aksinça, xlorid ionlari kabi manfiy ionlar kanal oğzidagi kuçli manfiy zaryadlar ularni itarişi sababli ötmaydi.

ch07-f16.text: Amalda atsetilxolinga boğliq kanallar orqali ikki sababga köra natriy ionlari boşqa har qanday ionga qaraganda ança köp oqib ötadi. Birinçidan, yuqori konsentratsiyada mavjud bölgan musbat ionlar faqat ikkita: hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikdagi natriy ionlari va hujayra içi suyuqligidagi kaliy ionlari. Ikkinçidan, muskul membranasining içki tomonidagi −80 dan −90 millivoltgaça bölgan manfiy potensial musbat zaryadlangan natriy ionlarini tola içiga tortadi va bir vaqtning özida musbat zaryadlangan kaliy ionlari taşqariga ötişga uringanda ularning çiqişiga tösqinlik qiladi.

ch07-f17.text: **Rasm 7-3B** da körsatilganidek, atsetilxolinga boğliq kanallar oçilişining asosiy ta’siri — natriy ionlarining özlari bilan musbat zaryadlarni olib, tola içiga oqib kirişiga imkon beriş. Bu muskul tolasi membranasi içida _oxirgi plastinka potensiali_ deb ataladigan mahalliy musbat potensial özgarişini hosil qiladi. Bu oxirgi plastinka potensiali me’yorda qöşni potensialga boğliq natriy kanallarini oçiş uçun yetarli depolyarizatsiyani yuzaga keltiradi; bu natriy ionlarining yanada köproq kirişiga imkon beradi va muskul membranasi böylab tarqalib, muskul qisqarişiga sabab böladigan harakat potensialini boşlab beradi.

ch07-f18.text: Sinaptik böşliqqa çiqarilgan atsetilxolin böşliqda saqlanib turar ekan, atsetilxolin retseptorlarini faollaştirişda davom etadi. Biroq u _atsetilxolinesteraza_ fermenti tomonidan tez parçalanadi; bu ferment asosan presinaptik nerv terminali bilan postsinaptik muskul membranasi orasidagi sinaptik böşliqni töldirib turuvçi nozik biriktiruvçi töqimaning ğovak qatlamiga birikkan böladi. Atsetilxolinning oz qismi sinaptik böşliqdan taşqariga diffuziyalanib ketadi va keyin muskul tolasi membranasiga ta’sir qila olmaydi.
ch07-f18.lead: Ajralib çiqqan atsetilxolinning atsetilxolinesteraza tomonidan parçalanişi.

ch07-f19.text: Atsetilxolinning sinaptik böşliqda qoladigan qisqa vaqti — köpi bilan bir neça millisekund — me’yorda muskul tolasini qözğatiş uçun yetarli. Söngra atsetilxolinning tez yöqotilişi muskul tolasi dastlabki harakat potensialidan tiklanganidan keyin muskulning qayta-qayta qözğalişining oldini oladi.

ch07-f20.text: Atsetilxolinga boğliq kanallar oçilganda natriy ionlarining muskul tolasiga tösatdan yopirilib kirişi tola içidagi elektr potensialini _oxirgi plastinkaning mahalliy sohasida_ musbat tomonga 50–75 millivoltgaça oşiradi va _oxirgi plastinka potensiali_ deb ataladigan _mahalliy potensial_ hosil qiladi. 5-bobdan eslaylik: nerv membranasi potensialining 20–30 millivoltdan ortiq tösatdan oşişi odatda tobora köproq natriy kanallarining oçilişini boşlaş va şu tariqa muskul tolasi membranasida harakat potensialini yuzaga keltiriş uçun yetarli.
ch07-f20.lead: Oxirgi plastinka potensiali va skelet muskul tolasining qözğalişi.

ch07-f21.text: **Rasm 7-4** da harakat potensialini boşlab beruvçi oxirgi plastinka potensiali tasvirlangan. Bu rasmda uçta alohida oxirgi plastinka potensiali körsatilgan. A va C oxirgi plastinka potensiallari harakat potensialini yuzaga keltiriş uçun juda kuçsiz, biroq rasmda qayd etilganidek, ular oxirgi plastinkada kuçsiz mahalliy kuçlaniş özgarişlarini hosil qiladi. Aksinça, B oxirgi plastinka potensiali ança kuçli bölib, yetarliça köp natriy kanallarining oçilişiga sabab böladi va tola içiga tobora köproq natriy ionlari oqib kirişining öz-özini kuçaytiruvçi ta’siri harakat potensialini boşlab beradi. A nuqtadagi oxirgi plastinka potensialining kuçsizligi muskul tolasining _kurare_ bilan zaharlanişi natijasidir; bu dori atsetilxolin retseptor joylari uçun raqobatlaşib, atsetilxolinning atsetilxolin kanallariga darvozalovçi ta’sirini tösib qöyadi. C nuqtadagi oxirgi plastinka potensialining kuçsizligi esa nerv terminallaridan ajraladigan atsetilxolin miqdorini kamaytiruvçi bakterial zahar — _botulinik toksin_ ta’siri natijasidir.

ch07-f23.text: Odatda nerv-muskul sinapsiga yetib kelgan har bir impuls muskul tolasini qözğatiş uçun zarur bölganidan taxminan uç baravar katta oxirgi plastinka potensialini hosil qiladi. Şuning uçun me’yoriy nerv-muskul sinapsi yuqori _xavfsizlik omiliga_ ega deyiladi. Biroq nerv tolasining bir neça daqiqa davomida sekundiga 100 martadan köproq çastotada qözğatilişi atsetilxolin pufakçalari sonini şu qadar kamaytirişi mumkinki, impulslar muskul tolasiga ötmay qoladi. Bu holat nerv-muskul sinapsining _çarçaşi_ deb ataladi; xuddi şu hodisa markaziy nerv tizimida sinapslar haddan taşqari qözğatilganda ularning çarçaşiga sabab böladi. Me’yoriy faoliyat şaroitida nerv-muskul sinapsining ölçab böladigan darajadagi çarçaşi kamdan-kam kuzatiladi, kuzatilganda ham faqat muskul faoliyatining eng toliqtiruvçi darajalarida yuz beradi.
ch07-f23.lead: Nerv-muskul sinapsida uzatilişning xavfsizlik omili — sinapsning çarçaşi.

ch07-f24.text: Nerv-muskul sinapsida atsetilxolinning hosil bölişi va ajralişi quyidagi bosqiçlarda sodir böladi: 1. Orqa miyadagi motoneyron tanasida Golji apparati ölçami taxminan 40 nanometr bölgan mayda pufakçalarni hosil qiladi. Söngra bu pufakçalar orqa miyadagi markaziy hujayra tanasidan periferik nerv tolalarining uçlaridagi nerv-muskul sinapsigaça akson özagi böylab oqadigan aksoplazma yordamida taşiladi. Bitta skelet muskul oxirgi plastinkasining nerv terminallarida bunday mayda pufakçalardan taxminan 300 000 tasi töplanadi. 2. Atsetilxolin nerv tolasi terminalining sitozolida sintezlanadi, biroq darhol pufakçalar membranalari orqali ularning içiga taşiladi va u yerda yuqori konsentratsiyali şaklda — har bir pufakçada taxminan 10 000 atsetilxolin molekulasi holida saqlanadi. 3. Harakat potensiali nerv terminaliga yetib kelganda nerv terminali membranasidagi köplab _kalsiy kanallarini_ oçadi, çunki bu terminalda potensialga boğliq kalsiy kanallari juda köp. Natijada terminal membranasi içidagi kalsiy ionlari konsentratsiyasi taxminan 100 baravar ortadi, bu esa öz navbatida atsetilxolin pufakçalarining terminal membranasi bilan qöşiliş tezligini taxminan 10 000 baravar oşiradi. Bu qöşiliş köplab pufakçalarning yorilişiga va atsetilxolinning sinaptik böşliqqa _ekzotsitoziga_ imkon beradi. Har bir harakat potensialida odatda taxminan 125 ta pufakça yoriladi. Söngra bir neça millisekunddan keyin atsetilxolin atsetilxolinesteraza tomonidan atsetat ioni va xolinga parçalanadi, xolin esa yangi atsetilxolin hosil qilişda qayta foydalaniş uçun nerv terminaliga faol qayta söriladi. Bu hodisalar ketma-ketligi 5–10 millisekund içida sodir böladi. 4. Nerv uçidagi mavjud pufakçalar soni nervdan muskulga faqat bir neça ming impulsni uzatiş uçun yetarli. Şuning uçun nerv-muskul sinapsining uzluksiz işlaşi uçun yangi pufakçalar tez qayta hosil bölişi kerak. Har bir harakat potensiali tugaganidan keyin bir neça sekund içida terminal nerv membranasida qoplangan çuqurçalar paydo böladi; ularni nerv uçidagi qisqaruvçi oqsillar, ayniqsa dastlabki pufakçalar joylaşgan sohalarda membranaga birikkan _klatrin_ oqsili hosil qiladi. Taxminan 20 sekund içida bu oqsillar qisqaradi va çuqurçalarning membrana içiga uzilib tuşişiga sabab bölib, yangi pufakçalarni hosil qiladi. Yana bir neça sekund içida atsetilxolin bu pufakçalar içiga taşiladi va ular atsetilxolin ajratişning yangi sikliga tayyor böladi.

ch07-f25.text: _Metaxolin, karbaxol_ va _nikotin_ kabi birikmalar muskul tolasiga atsetilxolin bilan deyarli bir xil ta’sir körsatadi. Uşbu dorilar va atsetilxolin örtasidagi asosiy farqlar şundan iboratki, dorilar xolinesteraza tomonidan parçalanmaydi yoki şunçalik sekin parçalanadiki, ularning ta’siri köpinça bir neça daqiqadan bir neça soatgaça davom etadi. Dorilar atsetilxolin retseptorlari joylaşgan motor plastinkada muskul tola membranasi depolarizatsiyasining lokal hududlarini keltirib çiqariş orqali işlaydi. Keyinçalik, muskul tolasi oldingi qisqarişdan har safar tiklanganda, bu depolarizatsiyalangan hududlar, ionlarning sizib çiqişi tufayli, yangi harakat potensialini boşlab beradi va şu tariqa muskul spazmi holatini keltirib çiqaradi.
ch07-f25.lead: Atsetilxolinga öxşaş ta’sir körsatib, muskul tolasini qözğatuvçi dorilar.

ch07-f26.text: Uçta juda maşhur dori – _neostigmin, fizostigmin_ va _diizopropilftorfosfat_ sinapslardagi atsetilxolinesterazani inaktivatsiya qiladi, şuning uçun u endi atsetilxolinni gidroliz qilmaydi. Şuning uçun, har bir keyingi nerv impulsi bilan qöşimça atsetilxolin töplanadi va muskul tolasini qayta-qayta qözğatadi. Bu faollik hatto bir neçta nerv impulslari muskulga yetib borganda ham _muskul spazmini_ keltirib çiqaradi. Afsuski, u şuningdek, insonni böğib qöyadigan hiqildoq spazmi natijasida ölimga olib kelişi mumkin.
ch07-f26.lead: Atsetilxolinesterazani inaktivatsiya qiliş orqali nerv-muskul birikmasini qözğatuvçi dorilar.

ch07-f27.text: Neostigmin va fizostigmin bir neça soatgaça atsetilxolinesterazani inaktivatsiya qiliş uçun u bilan birikadi, şundan söng bu dorilar atsetilxolinesterazadan siqib çiqariladi, şunda esteraza yana faol bölib qoladi. Aksinça, kuçli nerv gazi zahri bölgan diizopropilftorfosfat atsetilxolinesterazani haftalab inaktivatsiya qiladi, bu esa bu zaharni ayniqsa ölimga olib keluvçi qiladi.

ch07-f28.text: _Kurarimon dorilar_ deb nomlanuvçi dorilar guruhi impulslarning nerv oxiridan muskulga ötişining oldini olib turişi mumkin. Masalan, d-tubokurarin atsetilxolinning muskul tolasi atsetilxolin retseptorlariga ta’sirini bloklaydi, şu bilan harakat potensialini boşlaş uçun muskul membranasi kanallarining ötkazuvçanligi yetarliça oşişining oldini oladi.

ch07-f29.text: _Miassteniya gravis_ (Myasthenia gravis), taxminan har 20 000 kişidan 1 nafarida uçraydi, nerv tolalaridan muskul tolalariga yetarliça signallarni uzatiş uçun nerv-muskul birikmalarining qobiliyatsizligi tufayli muskul zaifligini keltirib çiqaradi. Atsetilxolin retseptorlariga hujum qiluvçi antitelolar miassteniya gravis bilan oğrigan köpçilik bemorlarning qonida aniqlangan. Şuning uçun, miassteniya gravis bemorlarda postsinaptik nerv-muskul birikmasida özlarining atsetilxolin retseptorlarini bloklaydigan yoki yöq qiladigan antitelolarni işlab çiqqan autoimmun kasallik deb hisoblanadi.

ch07-f30.text: Sababidan qat’i nazar, muskul tolalarida sodir böladigan oxirgi plastinka potensiallari kuçlanişga boğliq natriy kanallarining oçilişini boşlaş uçun asosan juda zaif böladi va muskul tolasi depolarizatsiyasi sodir bölmaydi. Agar kasallik yetarliça kuçli bölsa, bemor nafas oliş muskullarining oğir zaiflaşişi natijasida nafas yetişmovçiligidan vafot etişi mumkin. Kasallik odatda _neostigmin_ yoki sinaptik fazoda odatdagidan köproq miqdordagi atsetilxolinning töplanişiga imkon beradigan boşqa antixolinesteraza dorisini yuboriş orqali bir neça soat davomida yaxşilanişi mumkin. Bir neça daqiqada ta’sirlanganlarning ba’zilari bir neça soatdan keyin yangi neostigmin dozasi talab qilinmagunça deyarli normal işlay boşlaşi mumkin.

ch07-f32.text: 5-bobda nerv tolalarida harakat potensiallarining boşlanişi va ötkazilişi böyiça muhokama qilingan deyarli hamma narsa miqdoriy farqlardan taşqari skelet muskul tolalariga ham birdek tegişli. Muskul potensiallarining miqdoriy jihatlaridan ba’zilari quyidagilardan iborat: 1. Skelet tolalarida tinçlik membranasi potensiali taxminan –80 dan –90 millivoltgaça bölib, neyronlardagiga qaraganda taxminan 10–20 millivoltga manfiyroq. 2. Harakat potensialining davomiyligi skelet muskullarida 1–5 millisekundni taşkil qiladi, bu yirik miyelinli nervlardagiga qaraganda taxminan beş baravar uzun. 3. Ötkazuvçanlik tezligi 3–5 m/s ni taşkil qiladi, bu skelet muskulini qözğatuvçi yirik miyelinli nerv tolalaridagi ötkazuvçanlik tezligining taxminan 1/13 qismiga teng.

ch07-f33.text: Harakat potensiallarining köndalang nayçalar orqali muskul tolasining içki qismiga tarqalişi

ch07-f34.text: Skelet muskul tolasi şunçalik kattaki, uning sirt membranasi böylab tarqaladigan harakat potensiallari tolaning çuqur qismida deyarli tok oqişini keltirib çiqarmaydi. Biroq, maksimal muskul qisqarişi tokning muskul tolasi içiga çuqur kirib borişini va alohida miofibrillalar atrofiga yetib kelişini talab qiladi. Uşbu kirib boriş **Rasm 7-5** da körsatilgandek, muskul tolasining bir çetidan ikkinçi çetigaça, butun muskul tolasi böylab kirib boruvçi _köndalang nayçalar_ (T nayçalar) böylab harakat potensiallarini ötkaziş orqali erişiladi. T nayça harakat potensiallari muskul tolasi içida miofibrillalarning bevosita yaqinida kaltsiy ionlarining ajralib çiqişiga sabab böladi va bu kaltsiy ionlari keyin qisqarişni keltirib çiqaradi. Umumiy jarayon _qözğatiş-qisqariş_ boğlanişi deb ataladi.

ch07-f38.text: **Rasm 7-5**da T nayça – sarkoplazmatik retikulum tizimi bilan öralgan miofibrillar körsatilgan. T nayçalar kiçik bölib, miofibrillarga köndalang yönalişda ötadi. Ular hujayra membranali sathidan boşlanib, muskul tolasining bir tomonidan qarama-qarşi tomonigaça butunlay ötib boradi. Rasmda körsatilmagan bölsa-da, bu nayçalar özaro tarmoqlanib, barça alohida miofibrillar orasida tör hosil qiluvçi T nayçalarning butun _tekisliklarini_ hosil qiladi. Şuningdek, _T nayçalar hujayra membranasidan boşlanadigan joyida muskul tolasining taşqi muhitiga oçiq böladi._ Şuning uçun ular muskul tolasini örab turgan hujayrataşqi suyuqlik bilan muloqot qiladi va öz lümenida hujayrataşqi suyuqlikni saqlaydi. Boşqaça qilib aytganda, _T nayçalar aslida hujayra membranasining içki davomi hisoblanadi_. Şuning uçun, harakat potensiali muskul tolasi membranasi böylab tarqalganida, potensial özgarişi ham T nayçalar böylab muskul tolasining çuqur içki qismiga tarqaladi. Uşbu T nayçalarni örab turgan elektr toki keyinçalik muskul qisqarişini keltirib çiqaradi.

ch07-f39.text: **Rasm 7-5**da, şuningdek, sariq rangda sarkoplazmatik _retikulum_ körsatilgan. Uşbu sarkoplazmatik retikulum ikkita asosiy qismdan iborat: (1) T nayçalar bilan tutaşgan _terminal sisternalar_ deb ataluvçi yirik kameralar; va (2) qisqaruvçi miofibrillarning barça yuzalarini örab turgan uzun böylama nayçalar.

ch07-f40.text: Sarkoplazmatik retikulum tomonidan kalsiy ionlarining çiqarilişi

ch07-f41.text: Sarkoplazmatik retikulumning öziga xos xususiyatlaridan biri şundaki, uning pufakçali nayçalari içida yuqori konsentratsiyadagi kalsiy ionlari ortiği bilan mavjud böladi. Qöşni T nayçada harakat potensiali yuzaga kelganda, bu ionlarning köp qismi har bir pufakçadan çiqariladi.

ch07-f42.text: **Rasm 7-6 va 7-7**da körsatilişiça, T nayçaning harakat potensiali T nayça bilan tutaşgan sarkoplazmatik retikulum sisternalariga oqim ötişini keltirib çiqaradi. Harakat potensiali T nayçaga yetib kelişi bilan, kuçlaniş özgarişi qöşni sarkoplazmatik retikulum sisternalaridagi _kalsiy çiqaruvçi kanallar_ (şuningdek, _rianodin retseptor kanallari_ deb ham ataladi) bilan boğlangan digidropiridin _retseptorlari_ tomonidan seziladi (**Rasm 7-6**ni qarang). Digidropiridin retseptorlarining faollaşişi sisternalardagi, şuningdek ularga biriktirilgan böylama nayçalardagi kalsiy çiqaruvçi kanallarning oçilişini keltirib çiqaradi. Bu kanallar bir neça millisekund davomida oçiq qoladi, kalsiy ionlarini miofibrillarni örab turgan sarkoplazmaga çiqaradi va 6-bobda muhokama qilinganidek qisqarişni keltirib çiqaradi.

ch07-f45.text: Kalsiy ionlari sarkoplazmatik nayçalardan çiqarilgandan va miofibrillar orasida diffuziyalangandan söng, kalsiy ionlari konsentratsiyasi yuqori bölib qolgunça muskul qisqarişi davom etadi. Biroq, sarkoplazmatik retikulum devorlarida joylaşgan doimiy faol kalsiy nasosi kalsiy ionlarini miofibrillardan uzoqlaştirib, yana sarkoplazmatik nayçalarga haydaydi (**Rasm 7-6**ni qarang). SERCA (**s**arkoplazmatik **r**etikulum **C**a2+-**A**TPase) deb ataladigan uşbu nasos nayçalar içidagi kalsiy ionlari konsentratsiyasini taxminan 10 000 marta oşirişi mumkin. Bundan taşqari, retikulum içida har bir kalsiysekvestrin molekulasiga 40 tagaça kalsiy ionini boğlay oladigan _kalsiy boğlovçi oqsil_ – _kalsiysekvestrin_ mavjud.
ch07-f45.lead: Kalsiy nasosi qisqariş sodir bölgandan keyin miofibrillar suyuqligidan kalsiy ionlarini çiqarib yuboradi.

ch07-f46.text: Miofibrillarni qoplab yotuvçi sitozoldagi kalsiy ionlarining normal tinç holatdagi konsentratsiyasi (<10−7 M) qisqarişni keltirib çiqariş uçun juda kamlik qiladi. Şuning uçun troponin-tropomiorozin kompleks aktin filamentlarini tormozlangan holda saqlaydi va muskulning böşaşgan holatini ta’minlaydi.

ch07-f47.text: Aksinça, T nayça va sarkoplazmatik retikulum tizimining töliq qözğalişi miofibrillar suyuqligidagi konsentratsiyani 2 × 10−4 molyar konsentratsiyagaça, ya’ni 500 marta oşiriş uçun yetarli miqdorda kalsiy ionlari çiqarilişini keltirib çiqaradi, bu maksimal muskul qisqarişini keltirib çiqariş uçun zarur bölgan darajadan taxminan 10 marta köpdir. Şundan söng darhol kalsiy nasosi kalsiy ionlarini yana kamaytiradi. Odatdagi skelet muskul tolasida bu kalsiy impulsining umumiy davomiyligi taxminan 1/20 sekundni taşkil qiladi, garçi ba’zi tolalarda bundan bir neça marta uzunroq, boşqalarida esa bir neça marta qisqaroq bölişi mumkin. Yurak muşagida kalsiy impulsi yurak harakat potensialining uzoq davom etişi tufayli taxminan uçdan bir sekund davom etadi.

ch07-f48.text: Uşbu kalsiy impulsi davomida muskul qisqarişi sodir böladi. Agar qisqariş uzoq vaqt davomida uzilişlarsiz davom etişi kerak bölsa, 6-bobda muhokama qilinganidek, takrorlanuvçi harakat potensiallarining uzluksiz seriyasi orqali kalsiy impulslari seriyasini boşlaş kerak.

ch07-f49.text: Meylkan şaxslarda _malignant gipertermiya_ va _gipermetabolik kriz_ galotan va izoflyuran kabi ayrim turdagi anestetiklar yoki suksinilxolin ta’sirida qözğatilişi mumkin. Kamida oltita genetik mutatsiya, ayniqsa rianodin retseptorlari yoki degidropiridin retseptorlari genlarining mutatsiyalari anesteziya paytida malignant gipertermiyaning rivojlaniş moyilligini keskin oşirişi körsatilgan. Anestetiklarning malignant gipertermiyani qözğatiş uçun uşbu ğayritabiiy retseptorlar bilan özaro ta’sir qiluvçi öziga xos mexanizmlari haqida kam narsa ma’lum. Biroq, bu mutatsiyalar kalsiyning sarkoplazmatik retikulumdan hujayra içki böşliqlariga nazoratsiz ötişiga sabab bölişi ma’lum, bu öz navbatida muskul tolalarining haddan taşqari qisqarişiga olib keladi. Uşbu davomiy muskul qisqarişlari metabolizm tezligini keskin oşiradi, köp miqdorda issiqlik hosil qiladi va hujayraviy atsidozni, şuningdek, energiya zaxiralarining tugaşini keltirib çiqaradi.

ch07-f50.text: Malignant gipertermiyaning alomatlariga muskul rigidligi, yuqori isitma va tez yurak urişi kiradi. Oğir holatlarda qöşimça asoratlar skelet muskulining tez parçalanişini (_rabdomioliz_) va şikastlangan muskul hujayralaridan köp miqdorda kaliy çiqarilişi tufayli plazmada yuqori kaliy miqdorini öz içiga olişi mumkin. Malignant gipertermiyani davolaş odatda tez sovutişni va rianodin retseptorlarini antagonizatsiya qiluvçi, sarkoplazmatik retikulumdan kalsiy ionlarining çiqişini tormozlovçi va şu tariqa muskul qisqarişini susaytiruvçi dori – _dantrolen_ administratsiyasini öz içiga oladi.
